title: Overview: choose the structure
question: Three ways to make Overview answer "where do I stand?". Same Calm Ledger look in all three; the difference is what leads and how the page divides. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Owed to you | You owe
options.thesis: Two facing columns, money in and money out, with the net as the balance line underneath.
options.viewport: Header with net sentence; left column people who owe you (green), right column people you owe (oxblood), each row with a Settle up action; a totals line; below, groups and recent activity side by side and a slim month-spend strip.
options.risk: When one side is empty the page looks lopsided; needs a designed empty column.

options.label: One list of people
options.thesis: Every person you share money with in one list, sorted by size, each balance drawn as a bar either side of zero.
options.viewport: Net figure and a one-line summary on top; a single people table where each row is name, shared groups, a bar growing right (owes you) or left (you owe), the amount and a Settle up button; groups, activity and month spend in a right rail.
options.risk: Bars can read as a chart to admire rather than a list to act on if the actions are quiet.

options.label: Group by group
options.thesis: Each group is a section showing where you stand in it and the payments that would clear it.
options.viewport: Overall net and month spend in a header band; then one section per group (Flat 4B, Goa trip) with your net in that group, its member balances and its fewest-payments list; recent activity in a right rail.
options.risk: The same person in two groups shows twice, so your overall position with a friend is never in one place.
